Panneerselvam Denies Rumors of Switching Allegiance

Former Tamil Nadu Chief Minister O. Panneerselvam has addressed speculation about switching his political party. He has publicly denied these rumors and reaffirmed his loyalty to the DMK. This comes amid ongoing discussions and media reports about potential party shifts.
